name: Frame Window
description: Click buffering and a minimum hold length, with a simple settings UI.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the mod on or off.

click-window.name: Click Window (frames)
click-window.description: How many frames after a click the click keeps counting. 1 = vanilla.

min-hold.name: Minimum Hold (frames)
min-hold.description: Every hold lasts at least this many frames. Early releases are delayed. 1 = vanilla.
